headlines.title: Trump says he wants to ‘get Cuba done’ when asked about use of military force
headlines.description: President Donald Trump signaled in a new interview that he could take military action against Cuba before he leaves office to topple the island’s communist regime.

headlines.title: Commerce Secretary Lutnick agrees to testify about Nvidia
headlines.description: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick agreed to testify before Congress over national security concerns regarding the expanding Nvidia scandal. NBC News’ Yamiche Alcindor details bipartisan concern and White House reaction.

headlines.title: Van Hollen Challenges Schumer for Senate Majority Leader
headlines.description: Maryland Sen. Chris Van Hollen announced Thursday he will run for Senate majority leader, becoming the first to challenge Sen. Chuck Schumer for the position. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s Resignation Rattles Global Markets
headlines.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s sudden resignation following an admitted affair with a woman thought by intelligence officials to be a Chinese spy, is sending shockwaves through the AI industry and global financial markets. Now, some lawmakers are calling for investigations into whether U.S. security has been compromised by Huang’s actions. NBC’s Brian Cheung reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: How the White House Correspondents’ Association dinner chaos unfolded
headlines.description: Secret Service faced challenges evacuating President, Vice President, Cabinet officials and Congressional leaders after gunman rushes D.C. gala.

headlines.title: Howard Lutnick will testify as bipartisan pressure grows over Nvidia scandal
headlines.description: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who was also requested to testify, had previously praised the commerce secretary for his support and involvement in the industry.

headlines.title: Sen. Chris Van Hollen says he will challenge Sen. Chuck Schumer for majority leader
headlines.description: Sen. Chris Van Hollen, D-Md., announced Thursday he will run for Senate majority leader, becoming the first to challenge Sen. Chuck Schumer, D-N.Y.

headlines.title: Democrats can’t wait until after Trump to produce results, James Talarico says
headlines.description: DENVER — Texas Sen.-elect James Talarico told a gathering of Democrats on Thursday that voters are expecting them to immediately deliver and that means making President Donald Trump’s last two years in office the “most productive of any presidency in American history.”

headlines.title: Ukraine faces new Starshield disruptions as Trump envoys meet with Putin
headlines.description: Hours after an American delegation touched down in Moscow for peace talks, Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said his country’s military had experienced a renewed wave of “significant disruptions” to the Starshield satellite internet service, hampering its ability to defend itself against Russia.

headlines.title: DOJ has no ‘investigations into words’ of Democrats, Todd Blanche says
headlines.description: Attorney General Todd Blanche says there are no investigations into words of Democrats

headlines.title: Democrat Cindy Holscher defeats Republican Ty Masterson in Kansas governor’s race
headlines.description: Democratic state Sen. Cindy Holscher has narrowly won Kansas’ race for governor, NBC News projected Thursday, extending the party’s hold on the office in the red state.

headlines.title: Trump’s FDA pick faces Republican doubts as confirmation deadline nears
headlines.description: The FDA is set to finish its safety review of the abortion pill mifepristone in March, setting up one of the most politically charged decisions the agency has faced in years.
